key_points: Reported US restrictions on Chinese data center equipment imports lifted GLW and optical peers (Lumentum, Coherent) on Nov 17; potential share gain for domestic optical suppliers
Rules are only reported, not formal, and face opposition from major US tech companies, so timing and magnitude are uncertain
Seeking Alpha upgrade calls GLW a buy after the recent selloff, supporting a rebound case
Stock fell ~6.7% on Nov 16 and underperformed peers, so part of the rally is a bounce off oversold levels
$22B hedge fund fully exited GLW in Q3 13F — stale but a mild sentiment overhang
